<!-- Generated by tools/docs/generate.py from the Makefile's help text. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run `make help` for the same list.

| Target | What it does |
|---|---|
| `make install` | uv sync (dev + all extras) |
| `make lint` | ruff check |
| `make type` | mypy --strict on hardened modules |
| `make type-v1` | V1 Gateway/Admin/worker/stable-connector baseline gate |
| `make test-unit` | pytest -m 'not integration and not e2e and not load' |
| `make test-integration` | local/mocked integration suite; explicitly excludes live credentials |
| `make test-mcp-sdk` | official MCP 2026 SDK wire compatibility |
| `make test-e2e` | pytest -m e2e against an already-running seeded E2E stack |
| `make test-browser` | Playwright Admin certification against seeded E2E stack |
| `make browser-install` | install the pinned Chromium browser for certification |
| `make check` | lint + type + unit + integration |
| `make check-quick` | lint + unit only |
| `make e2e-up` | build/start compose + E2E overlay |
| `make e2e-seed` | seed the running E2E stack |
| `make e2e-down` | tear down E2E stack and volumes |
| `make e2e-logs` | print E2E stack logs |
| `make e2e` | clean start + seed + full E2E suite + teardown |
| `make load` | load tests (compose-backed) |
| `make smoke-eval` | quick start as an acceptance test on a fresh stack (Docker) |
| `make secret-scan` | scan tracked files for known sensitive live artifacts |
| `make docs-generate` | regenerate the docs site's reference pages from the code |
| `make docs-check` | fail if a generated docs page is stale |
| `make docs-licenses` | licence and source gate for the docs site's npm packages |
| `make docs-build` | build the docs site (needs Node 24) |
| `make docs-screenshots` | capture docs screenshots from a running stack |
| `make docs-screenshots-stack` | bring up the e2e stack, capture, tear down |
| `make security` | secret-scan + bandit + pip-audit |
| `make audit-cover` | verify_audit_coverage.py |
| `make requirements-production` | regenerate hash-pinned production export |
| `make sbom` | generate CycloneDX production SBOM from uv.lock |
| `make cve-scan` | pip-audit production requirements into CycloneDX report |
| `make license-report` | licence inventory of the published image; fails on a licence outside the allowlist |
| `make release-evidence` | requirements check + SBOM + CVE + license evidence |
| `make docker-build` | build local InterLock runtime image |
| `make terraform-validate` | offline terraform fmt/validate for both cloud roots |
| `make actionlint` | lint GitHub Actions workflows |
| `make check-infra` | terraform-validate + actionlint + helm-render |
| `make helm-render` | render Helm manifests with the local helm CLI |
| `make final-boss-local` | full local public-beta release gate, no live credentials |
| `make final-boss` | alias for final-boss-local |
| `make live-check` | offline: parse credentials, verify the matrix pin |
| `make live-up` | compose stack with live credentials in the gateway |
| `make live-seed` | register the five live systems as governed sources |
| `make test-live-upstream` | Tier 0: upstreams and privileges, no InterLock |
| `make test-live-governed` | Tier 1: governance against the live upstreams |
| `make live-certify` | seed, run both tiers, write the report, tear down |
| `make live-teardown` | remove every live_cert_* control-plane object |
| `make live-sweep` | delete orphaned artifacts left by a killed run |
